522.synopsis:
While trying to enroll in college and having fallen into a desperate situation, the book-loving high school student Kazami Ayame was, while coming across an eerie book, suddenly flung into a different world.
With no combat ability, and without even any knowledge on how to live properly in the first place, what was granted to him by a single copy of a magical grimoire, was the ability to draw out the magical energy from objects.
With the knowledge on how to freely use the power granted by the magic grimiore, Ayame struggles to survive in the harsh other world.
Surrounded by books and beautiful women. In order to obtain his ideal lifestyle. Although there are battles with demons, this is fundamentally a heartwarming fantasy story.

He is the big brother in the triad which battles and reigns in terror,
Unfortunately, he likes the woman who whole-heartedly adores his respected sworn brother,
This woman who he has taught and trained single-handedly,

12042.synopsis:
Lain Jang is a lawyer. However, he got fired from the law firm because some crazy client proposed to him. On top of that, he bumped into a new model foreign car, a black Jaguar. The owner of that Jaguar turned out to be the manager of a global star who then hired him when he found out that he was a lawyer. 
Lain, who thought he could make a living thanks to this, instead gained one more terribly ill-fated relationship. It was global top star Edan Blake. At first he blanked out due to the other’s dreamy looks and voice but he soon learned about his rotten personality  and came back to his senses. This is where his bad luck begins. 
He went there to be a lawyer but after he cleared his head he had somehow turned into the housekeeper of this person who believed that he was the only existence in the entire universe. To make matters worse, an unfortunate accident occurs which even leads him to meet the crazy client who got him fired from the law firm…

17674.synopsis:
A small dungeon is fine. And yet I create a massive and powerful dungeon.
Chrono is an ordinary demon attending a dungeon creation class at the demon lord’s academy. Upon hitting 20 year’s old, Demonic Beings are encouraged to attend the academy and live there while perfecting the art of creating dungeons.
Chrono thinks that creating a small dungeon would be sufficient, however, what emerged was an extremely massive dungeon with hundreds of layers. Moreover, the level of the dungeon exceeded the dungeon created by the legendary demon king by a large margin.
「A small dungeon is all that I ask of….!」
Chrono who was looking for an ordinary and comfortable life quickly became the focus of attention of many and quickly rise up within the demonic society. It won’t take long until he was hailed a hero.

To his surprise, the lover he had thought had perished in that car crash ten years ago appeared in front of him once again. However, he had no memory of him nor the time they spent together…

As the compensation, Jian Rushi became the mistress of that man, who turned out to be a golden bachelor. And a series of embarrassing things happened…

Although orphaned at a young age, Mu Cheng does not let her past affect her and lives life with great passion and determination. A harmless bet brings the two together and Guang Xi slowly changes as Mu Cheng teaches him how to give and love. Tragedy strikes when Guang Xi suddenly has to go through a major brain surgery which causes him to lose his memory. His mother begs Mu Cheng to leave him and the latter has no choice but to do so. Little does she know that she already has Guang Xi’s child.
Six years pass. Mu Cheng lives a quiet life with her young son in the countryside while Guang Xi is now a successful lawyer and is engaged to He Yi Qian, the kind and beautiful doctor who took care of him after his surgery. A strangely familiar piano piece stirs Guang Xi’s heart as he struggles to recall his past romance with Mu Cheng. How will the couple make up for six years of lost time?

Your younger maternal aunt’s colleague’s younger brother is a 190 tall man. It’s just that he’s a bit dark…”

55818.synopsis:
All living beings in heaven and earth are guests in a tavern. The timescape is also an old customer.
The difference between life and death is like the difference between dreaming and waking. Even years of study might not reveal the truth of such complex transformations.
What awaits on the other side of life and death? What surpasses heaven and earth? What lies beyond the timescape?
In a world where the weak are devoured by the strong, survival is the only law.
After the descent of a mysterious “God”, the world fell into ruin. Its lingering aura polluted the land, corrupting even the resources needed for cultivation. Those who seek power must risk mutation or death.
The most powerful cultivators fled, taking humanity’s elites with them and abandoning the rest to a brutal, chaotic wasteland. Ferocious beasts roam freely, and the remnants of humanity, now a mere shadow of its former self, struggle and fight among themselves to survive.
Xu Qing is one of the forsaken.
Alone in this merciless world, his goals are simple: to survive, and to find his lost family. Yet as he walks the path of cultivation, he comes to realize a terrifying truth: power always comes at a cost, and the closer one draws to strength, the closer one drifts from their humanity.
Even so, amidst the cruelty, Xu Qing finds bonds of trust and companionship that give him a reason to keep moving forward.
If the heavens offer no salvation, then perhaps the only path left is to rise beyond them.

It was a parasitic statement that should never have been agreed upon. However, in the present, ten years later, they had become idols. In order to support me for the rest of my life!

The long and enjoyable days of summer vacation had ended, and a few days into the start of the second semester, on a day when Reina had arrived early to school for student council duties, Daiki, who had arrived at school alone, found a lost item while changing into indoor shoes at the shoe lockers near the front entrance of the school.
 This event shattered their daily life and led to the unraveling of the relationships among childhood friends.

‘These specs, this family history … Perfect. I wasn’t happy with that storyline. Now I can do all the ‘villain’ stuff I want.”
This is a heroic tale from the villain’s point of view, in which a man reincarnated as a kind-hearted character who was originally supposed to be the hero’s “best friend” repeatedly stands in front of the hero as a “necessary evil”.

72714.synopsis:

She was trembling all over from being f*cked. Coincidentally, her father also returned at this time and asked softly: “Why did you start eating without waiting for me?”
Jiang Qian was almost desperate and wanted to run back to her biological parents, but unfortunately, she was drugged and sent away as soon as they met. Afterwards, her emotions surged forward like a tide.
The devilish eldest brother, the green tea actor second brother, the little wolfdog third brother who always longed for her, and the doctor father who asked her gently if she dared to run away.

Although he thought that, he still had a child’s chubby body. There were limits to what he could do.

In a world where you either dominate or be dominated, the Korean Empire survived as an independent nation.

Lee Dojae, the third prince of the Korean Empire, couldn’t even dream of becoming a singer because of his royal bloodline.
“Always maintain dignity, be honorable, and beneficial wherever you are.”
This single line of belief constantly pierced Lee Dojae’s heart.
“A life where you can’t do anything by your own will.”
Lee Dojae’s pale face reflected on the darkened TV screen like an afterimage.
“…”
Seeing his own face on the screen, a surge of emotions welled up within him.
Living like he was present yet absent, like a floating debris—nobody else understood this, but Lee Dojae, who had dreams, did.
For the first time since he was eighteen, when he was whipped by his emperor father, Lee Dojae voiced the words he’d kept bottled up.
“I want to be a singer… I want to be a singer.”
At that moment, someone who looked exactly like him said something completely different from beyond the TV screen.

Armed with intel from his previous life, he laid out a thorough game plan, knowing that this crossing would send tens of millions of Blue Star people to that perilous Otherworld, where they would become Players blessed with systems, risking life and death.
But in this life, with the ability to foresee the future, he would change all the tragedies and personally take down that damned witch!
At least, that’s what Ye Xiao had thought. Yet when he opened his eyes after crossing over, and checked the character panel in his system, he was shocked to see his own avatar had become a silver-haired, red-eyed girl.
Wait—what’s going on here…?
He glanced down, noticing two rows of unfamiliar character information:
[Player Name: Ella Havier] 
[Title: Witch of the End]  
???
System, are you messing with me!!?
associated_names: 反派圣女大人是我的小号

115466.synopsis:
My ability that lets me absorb an entire being’s talents and powers.
But every once in a while—
◆ New Player Detected.
◆ Error: Duplicate Unique Perk detected.
◆ Unique Perk will be inherited by the new Player.
◆ Transferring Perk…
…I end up gaining something even I never imagined.
associated_names: Lord who levels up by eating abilities
The Lord Who Levels Up by Consuming Abilities
The Lord Who Levels Up by Eating Abilities

115978.synopsis:
He traveled thousands of miles back home to attend his brother’s wedding.
Mu Yu was the child born from his father’s affair. The Mu family never liked him.
Neither did Mu Hanxiao.

119050.synopsis:
Being a mountain goddess is a skilled job.
Every day, you must answer the prayers of devotees, inspect the growth of crops in the fields, drive away bandits and wild beasts from outside, ensure fair trade for merchant caravans, and find time to sneak into the city for some roast chicken.
And at night, you must strive for self-improvement….
“I surrender, I surrender! Please don’t tell anyone…!”
associated_names: 山神小姐，狐狸尾巴露出来啦

119306.synopsis:
That year, Bai Chen, the nine-tailed fox yao [supernatural creature] of the Great Snow Mountain, lost his magical inner core. A once-in-a-generation prodigy, he faded from the stage before ever stepping into the world. Knowing his days were numbered, Bai Chen asked for only one thing before death: a Dao companion he truly liked, someone who would light incense for him during festivals once he was gone.
Later, he drew his last breath — without ever marrying the one he had set his heart on. Perhaps the regret was too deep, for that final breath never fully left his chest.
It all felt like a long dream. When Bai Chen awoke, five hundred years had passed. The former young master of the Great Snow Mountain had become an ancestor of the yao race. And the man who once ignored him — Li Wuming — had, without permission, gone and married him!

121354.synopsis:
As a necromancer, Chen Mo’s style took a sharp turn into the absurd from the moment a bloodline sacrifice ritual accidentally connected him to his own motherland.
While others summon zombies, my skeletons wield automatic rifles for physical exorcism.
While others summon dark knights, my skeletons snipe with heavy rifles, one shot, one soul.
While others summon flesh giants, my skeletons drive Type 59 tanks, embodying the art of explosion.
When sky-obscuring bone dragon legions roar toward him, Chen Mo calmly turns around and meticulously inputs an absurdly long set of coordinates.
[Hercules–Corona Borealis Great Wall—KBC Void—Sloan Great Wall—Pisces–Cetus Supercluster Complex… (omitting countless astronomical units)… Inner Solar System—Luna System—Blue Star—Eastern Xia Republic] 
A colossal entity tears through the dimensional barrier and emerges in all its glory.
“Allow me to introduce to you all! The ultimate avatar of violence, the divine oracle of truth, the unrivaled dominator of the seven seas, hailing from the great industrial Cthulhu deity of the East: the Type 055 Guided-Missile Destroyer, equipped with 112 vertical launch systems, a 130mm naval gun, an 1130 close-in weapon system, and HQ-10 short-range air defense missiles.”
“Oh, and thanks to the floating runes provided by my magic mentor, this bad boy is now officially the Type 055 Spaceborne Guided-Missile Destroyer.”
“Now, with Big Brother here, no offense, but every single one of you is tr*sh!”

123402.synopsis:
Erald, a young man leading a harsh and neglected life under his stepmother’s family, one day encounters the beautiful second prince, Chalon, who is secretly wandering through the forest.
Captivated by his angelic charm, Erald falls in love at first sight. Chalon, meanwhile, is bound by the possessive affection of his elder brother, the crown prince, and longs for a true friend.
Drawn together by fate, the two begin to meet in a secluded forest villa, and before long, they become hopelessly entangled in a secret romance.
Then, a grand ball is held at the castle. Driven by a desperate desire to see Chalon again, Erald makes his way there—only to incur the wrath of the crown prince, who has discovered their forbidden bond…!?
A wildly popular, intensely passionate and sensual fairy tale!!
associated_names: シンデレラ王 ～罪を抱く二人～

141834.synopsis:
This is the story of a radiant girl of light and a brooding boy of darkness—falling in love in dazzling, rainbow-colored hues.
They sit in the same room, doing nothing but playing games.
And yet, as they spend those quiet moments together, the distance between their hearts begins to shrink.
The beloved web hit finally comes to print!
Asahi Hikari—school idol, tennis prodigy, and part-time model—is a sunshine-tier extrovert blessed with talent, looks, and popularity.
In stark contrast, her classmate Kageyama Reiya is a hardcore gamer and a gloom-and-doom introvert with serious otaku energy.
Two people from opposite worlds who were never meant to cross paths.
But everything changes when a chance encounter on a bus reveals their shared love for games.
From that day on, Hikari starts dropping by Reiya’s room every weekend.
Same room. Same games. Just the two of them.
As the weekends pile up, so does the warmth between them.
“Alright then, I’ll be over tomorrow at the usual time, so get ready, okay?”
This is the story of a girl of light and a boy of darkness—falling in love in a shimmer of rainbow colors.
associated_names: 光属性美少女の朝日さんがなぜか毎週末俺の部屋に入り浸るようになった件

153866.synopsis:
Ye Feng transmigrated and became the protagonist of a xianxia novel he had read.
But tragically, the novel turned out to be a villain-centric story.
He would be relentlessly suppressed by all kinds of villains carrying cheat systems, until eventually meeting his end.
Ye Feng racked his brains so hard it felt like his CPU was going to burn out, but still couldn’t think of any way to change his fate.
Helpless, he decided to slack off.
Unexpectedly, that activated the Slack-Off System.
Call off an engagement? Sure, let’s return the betrothal gifts too!
Labeled a good-for-nothing? Fine by me. At least I won’t waste thousands of years on detours!
Old man in the ring? If you’re so capable, do it yourself—stop feeding me empty promises!
Watching the Child of Destiny Ye Feng completely slack off, the villains started to panic.
“If you’re like this, how are we supposed to exploit you?!”
associated_names: 我選擇擺爛后，反派們都慌了！

202762.synopsis:
Standing before Richard, the transmigrator, were both good news and bad news.
Good news: He had transmigrated into the body of a wealthy young noble.
Bad news: He found himself in the unfamiliar land of Europa.
Good news: The Pohlania Republic was a prosperous nation blessed with abundant deposits of Star Steel.
Bad news: The date was September 1st, 939 of the Covenant Calendar, and Pohlania was about to be crushed by the Talmenreich Empire’s devastating Blitzkrieg.
As Richard watched the Stuka dive-bombers screaming down from the skies above, he felt like crying.
“This place is terrifying! Send me home already!”
Six years passed in the blink of an eye.
By then, Richard had earned many titles.
He was recognized by all Pohlanians as the greatest national hero of the twentieth century.
He was the nemesis of the Desert Fox.
He was the legendary White Death, credited with the highest number of enemy officer kills in history.
And he was the battlefield commander who led his nation from the brink of destruction to ultimate victory…
associated_names: 穿越异界：从狙击手到战地指挥官
